_notes: The offline place list the 'Where was this?' prompt suggests from (DESIGN.md D68).
Three states, because the Pacific USA dex's edible rule is already scoped to them
(D48) and the owner's catches are there. A tier is the only ranking the search has:
0 towns and cities, 1 the places you go on purpose — parks, reserves, campgrounds,
